help.controls.load: Loads an image: each column of the grid is one step, each selected pixel one note (pitch from color, force from saturation).
help.controls.reset: Resets every image adjustment to its default value (the image is not reloaded from disk).
help.controls.rotate: Rotates the image in 90° steps; reading direction and zones follow the displayed orientation.
help.controls.crop: Enables crop mode: draw a rectangle on the image to keep only that part.
help.controls.cropRatio: Forces the crop frame's aspect ratio (free, 1:1, 4:3, 3:2 or 16:9).
help.controls.transform: Opens the transform panel: fine rotation and vertical/horizontal perspective. Apply to confirm, cancel to revert.
help.controls.transformGrid: Shows or hides the reading grid overlaid on the image.
help.controls.showOriginal: Shows the original, unadjusted image. With the projection closed it replaces the grid in the main viewer; with it open it swaps the two stacked layers.
help.controls.columns: Number of columns of the reading grid; each column is played in turn. Changing it re-clips the zones. Double-click the count to type an exact value.
help.controls.contrast: Strengthens or softens the gap between dark and bright areas: high contrast gives crisp notes surrounded by silence. Double-click to reset.
help.controls.brightness: Lightens or darkens the image; brightness drives the note lengths when they are enabled, so it shapes the rhythm. Double-click to reset.
help.controls.vibrance: Boosts or reduces color intensity, more subtly than raw saturation: muted colors gain more than vivid ones. Double-click to reset.
help.controls.posterize: Reduces the number of brightness levels (2–64); few levels make the image binary, handy for rhythm. Double-click to turn off.
help.controls.texture: Boosts or softens fine detail at a small scale; a negative value smooths the sequence's note-to-note noise. Double-click to reset.
help.controls.clarity: Strengthens or softens local contrast between areas at a larger scale than texture, sharpening the sequence's sections. Double-click to reset.
help.controls.simplify: Flattens near-uniform color areas while keeping edges crisp (bilateral smoothing), for cleaner zones. Double-click to turn off.
help.controls.dither: Floyd–Steinberg dithering: quantizes each channel to a few levels and spreads the error onto neighbors, for a fine dot pattern. Click to toggle.
help.controls.ditherOptions: Opens the dithering options: number of levels and error diffusion.
help.controls.ditherLevels: Number of levels each color channel is quantized to (2 = pure black/white). Double-click to reset.
help.controls.ditherStrength: Share of the quantization error diffused onto neighbors: 0 = plain posterize, 100 = classic Floyd–Steinberg. Double-click to reset.
help.controls.ditherSerpentine: Alternates the scan direction every other row, spreading the error evenly and avoiding diagonal "worm" patterns.
help.controls.autoLevels: Stretches brightness onto the full range (the outer 0.5% of pixels is ignored); colors are preserved. Click to toggle.
help.controls.help: Enables contextual help: hover any control to show its explanation. Click again or press Escape to disable.
help.controls.mirror: Opens the image as a fullscreen projection on a second screen; double-click it to toggle fullscreen/floating. Active only with a second screen.
help.controls.mirrorZones: Cycles the zones shown in the projection: every synth, only the visible ones, or none. The main window keeps its own visibility.
help.controls.mirrorEffect: Masking effect of the projection stack: None (opaque), Drag (a fading trail behind each playhead) or Frontline (the perpendicular line).
help.controls.mirrorEffectOptions: Opens the active effect's options (length, color, fade); Escape or another click closes it.
help.controls.mirrorEffectDragLength: Length of the trail behind the playhead, in grid cells.
help.controls.mirrorEffectDragColored: Tints the trail with the synth's color (screen blend), making the reveal brighter and colored.
help.controls.mirrorEffectDragFade: Cells over which the trail's fade-out is spread, at its oldest end (0 = hard edge).
help.controls.mirrorEffectFrontlineLength: Extent of the line on each side of the playhead, in cells (0 = the whole line).
help.controls.mirrorEffectFrontlineColored: Tints the line with the synth's color (screen blend), making the reveal brighter and colored.
help.controls.mirrorEffectFrontlineFade: Cells over which the line's fade-out is spread, at each end (0 = hard edge).
help.controls.lfoPower: Turns this LFO on or off.
help.controls.lfoAssign: Assigns an LFO to this setting, or clears it with a double-click.
help.controls.lfoAssigned: This setting is driven by an LFO; double-click the dot to clear it.
help.config.openFile: Opens the global configuration file (default synth, note ranges, scales, max image size).
help.config.showShortcuts: Lists every keyboard shortcut and mouse gesture of the app.
help.session.save: Saves the whole session: image, adjustments and every synth with its zones and settings.
help.synthList.add: Adds a synthesizer; each owns its zones and plays in parallel with the others.
help.synthList.playAllStart: Starts every idle synth; when all play, stops them all. Color: green = none, orange = some, red = all.
help.synthList.panic: Cuts all sounding MIDI notes (for a stuck external instrument).
help.synth.midiPort: Output port of this synth: pick the instrument to drive. "Wysiwyl (virtual)" appears as a MIDI input in your DAW (Live/macOS: use the IAC bus).
help.synth.channel: MIDI channel (1–16). Notes, CC 7 and program changes target it: two synths on the same port and channel are heard as one.
help.synth.accentToggle: Scales each pixel's velocity by the accent level of the beat it starts on.
help.synth.accentStep: Accent level of this beat, cycled on click (off, strong, normal, weak). The multipliers are set in the config file.
help.synth.renameHint: Double-click the synth's name to rename it.
help.synth.dragHandle: Drag to move this synth in the stack; the stack is renumbered accordingly.
help.synth.infoToggle: Folds or unfolds the playback info: pixel, color (RGB/HSL), notes, velocity and allowed ranges. The fold applies to every card.
help.synth.toggleMenu: Opens this synth's actions: save as default template, or copy parameters/zones from another synth.
help.synth.menuSaveTemplate: Makes this synth the default template for every new synth.
help.synth.menuCopyParams: Replaces this synth's sound and behaviour parameters with another's (its port and channel are kept).
help.synth.menuCopyZones: Copies another synth's zones here, replacing or merging them (disabled with a single synth).
help.synth.pickColor: Opens the palette to pick the identification color, used for the zones and highlight.
help.synth.remove: Removes the synth: a first click arms the button (red), a second within 3 s confirms.
help.synth.removeConfirm: Click again within 3 seconds to confirm the removal.
help.synth.addZone: Rectangle tool: drag to add pixels, click to select one. Alt removes, Shift toggles silence, Alt+Shift clears it. Usable while playing.
help.synth.addZoneLasso: Free-hand tool: every enclosed pixel (boundary included) is added on release. Alt removes, Shift toggles silence, Alt+Shift clears it.
help.synth.addZoneMagicWand: Magic wand: selects the in-tolerance pixels. Blue = connected only, orange = whole image. Modifiers as the rectangle tool (Alt removes, Shift toggles silence).
help.synth.magicWandTolerance: Largest per-channel color difference (1–255) accepted between the clicked pixel and the flooded ones.
help.synth.selectAllZones: Adds the whole image as the reading zone.
help.synth.clearZones: Removes every zone and manual silence of this synth; while playing it stops the synth.
help.synth.toggleHighlight: Shows or hides this synth's zone highlight on the image.
help.synth.toggleSort: On, the selected pixels are read by absolute position (one merged sweep); off, zone by zone in the order drawn.
help.synth.tempoRatio: Per-synth tempo, relative to the metronome (1/2 = twice as slow).
help.synth.toggleLoop: Loops the sequence; off, playback stops at its end.
help.synth.toggleBackAndForth: Plays forward then bounces back between both ends.
help.synth.rewind: Puts the playhead back at the start.
help.synth.stepForward: Advances by one step (one column) without starting continuous playback.
help.synth.volume: Channel volume as a raw MIDI value (0–127), sent as CC 7 and reasserted on play. CC 7 targets the channel, not the synth.
help.synth.mute: Silences this synth by setting its channel volume to 0 (CC 7), remembering its value.
help.synth.unmute: Restores this synth's channel volume to the value it had before muting.
help.synth.noteLengthSixteenth: Sixteenth note: a very short click.
help.synth.noteLengthHalf: Half note: sustained, notes slightly overlap.
help.synth.reverseNoteLength: Reverses the mapping: dark pixels give long notes, bright ones short.
help.synth.noteLengthTernary: Ternary division: triplets, 3 in the time of 2 (each length × 2/3).
help.synth.noteSustain: Sustained: each note holds its full length. Pizzicato: Note Off right after Note On, the instrument's release shapes the tail.
help.synth.noteLegato: Ties consecutive pixels of the same pitch into one held note (only with sustain and note lengths on).
help.synth.quantize: Locks the step grid on the metronome even with a non-integer tempo ratio; the period's offset is spread evenly over its notes (no held step).
help.synth.quantizeTempo: Resync period in beats (1–8): 1 realigns every beat, 8 every two bars.
help.synth.chance: Each step is played with the set probability, otherwise silenced (a rest); re-rolled every step.
help.synth.chanceProbability: Probability (1–100) that a step is played: 100 = every step, 10 = about one in ten.
help.synth.toggleRed: Plays only pixels with a red component above the threshold.
help.synth.toggleGreen: Plays only pixels with a green component above the threshold.
help.synth.toggleBlue: Plays only pixels with a blue component above the threshold.
help.synth.readingDirectionTitle: Order in which the pixels are read: left→right, right→left, top→bottom, bottom→top or a spiral.
help.synth.noteRangeBass: Restricts the notes to the bass range; the pitch rises across it as the hue (or channel value) increases.
help.synth.noteRangeMedium: Restricts the notes to the medium range; the pitch rises across it as the hue (or channel value) increases.
help.synth.noteRangeTreble: Restricts the notes to the treble range; the pitch rises across it as the hue (or channel value) increases.
help.synth.scale: Snaps every note to the nearest degree of the chosen scale, staying within the enabled range. Chromatic = no quantization.
help.synth.scaleRoot: Tonic (starting note) of the scale: degrees are counted from it.
help.synth.hueShift: Rotates the hue of the pixels before conversion, so the same image yields other notes.
help.synth.gridNoteInfo: Hover mode: shows the note this synth would play for the hovered pixel, accounting for scale, tonic, range and hue shift. One synth at a time; off with Esc.
help.synth.velocityRange: Velocity window: each note's force comes from the pixel's saturation, rescaled between the two bounds.
help.synth.velocityRelative: Relative: saturation is rescaled onto the whole min–max range. Clamp: computed on 1–127 then brought to the nearest bound.
help.synth.zonesBeatsInfo: Total reading duration of the selection in metronome beats: each pixel occupies its note length divided by the synth's tempo ratio; muted pixels count.
help.synth.silencePatternHint: Arms the pattern tool: click a zone to stamp the 16-step silence pattern, following the reading order.
help.synth.silencePatternStep: Toggles this step between silence and play.
help.synth.toggleInfiniteRepeat: Repeats the pattern across the whole zone instead of placing it once.
help.synth.programEditHint: Bank (A–P) and program (1–128) of this channel, sent immediately; also learned from the MIDI input and saved in the session.
help.synth.programBankManual: Bank (A–P) sent as Bank Select MSB; empty sends no Bank Select.
help.synth.programManual: Program (1–128) sent as Program Change to this channel.
help.metronome.syncBadge: The metronome follows an external MIDI clock: the tempo controls are disabled while it lasts.
help.metronome.clockMode: Timing source: Internal (own tempo), Auto (any incoming clock), Source (only the chosen input) or Master (broadcasts its clock while playing).
help.metronome.clockSource: Input port whose MIDI clock is followed in Source mode; "Wysiwyl (virtual)" is the app's own port.
help.metronome.masterBadge: The app broadcasts its own MIDI clock to every output while a synth plays; the tempo controls stay active.
help.metronome.timeSignature: Measure shared by the metronome and every synth (beats per bar and beat unit), used by the per-synth accents.
help.metronome.timeSignatureNumerator: Beats per bar (1–16); each beat gets one accent step.
help.metronome.timeSignatureDenominator: Note value of one beat (1, 2, 4, 8 or 16); sixteenth is the smallest exact unit.
help.update.check: Checks the GitHub releases for a newer stable version.
